name: 20 Minutes
source:
Short Visual Novel about the life of John and his couple Judy as they enjoy some good moments and support each other to deal with the hard ones in their life journey.

[From [url=https://primatedogma.itch.io/20-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述约翰与伴侣朱迪生活的短篇视觉小说。他们在人生旅途中享受美好的时光，也彼此支持，共同面对艰难的日子。

[摘自[url=https://primatedogma.itch.io/20-minutes]itch.io[/url]]
